source_refs.note: Pair Production: a main subheading of 12.3 Matter and anti-matter, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 264-264.

blocks.text: Pair production tab hota hai jab gamma ray photon (bohat zyada energy wala photon) kisi atomic nucleus ke qareeb se guzarta hai: photon khatam ho jata hai aur ek electron-positron pair (jora) ban jata hai (Fig. 12.1). Linear momentum conserve (barqarar) rakhne ke liye teesre particle, jaise nucleus, ka hona zaroori hai. Mass-energy equivalence (E = mc²) ke mutabiq photon ki minimum (kam se kam) energy dono naye particles ki rest mass energies ke jor ke barabar honi chahiye. Electron-positron pair ki rest mass energy 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV hai, aur experiments ne yeh confirm kiya hai. 1.02 MeV se kam energy wala gamma photon pair nahi bana sakta; 1.02 MeV se zyada energy wala photon pair banata hai aur bachi hui energy dono particles ki kinetic energy ban jati hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Pair production khaali jagah (vacuum ya space) mein nahi ho sakta. Yeh sirf tab hota hai jab koi bahar ki cheez, jaise atomic nucleus, maujood ho jo takkar mein thora peeche hat kar (recoil) energy aur momentum dono ko ek saath conserve rakhe.
Pair production mein charge, momentum aur energy, teenon conserve rehte hain: photon par charge zero tha, aur e⁻ aur e⁺ ke charges mil kar bhi zero hain.
